canonical_name: 萬界城／空胎內部 (Wanjie City / Empty Womb Interior)

visual_anchors.architecture_style: Mismatched rescued dark-fantasy stone districts joined by repaired bridges, canals, workshops and exposed civic infrastructure
visual_anchors.landscape_system: Qingjiao root-forest, grey-grain terraces, cemetery, black-sand work zones and multiple water routes contained by a thin translucent grey boundary membrane
visual_anchors.atmosphere_and_sky: Cold overcast inner-world sky with distant mountains and visibly incomplete spatial edges
visual_anchors.lighting_setup: Restrained cold ambient light with sparse warm work lamps and faint cyan boundary refraction
visual_anchors.color_theme: Charcoal stone, weathered wood, muted earth, grey-green crops, tarnished brass, restrained cyan
